identity.name: CIRCA at Clarendon
identity.notes: The restaurant-issued Clarendon location page and its exact linked ChowNow storefront both identify CIRCA at Clarendon at 3010 Clarendon Boulevard in Arlington. The separately listed Foggy Bottom, Navy Yard, and The Boro locations were not merged into this record.

sources.excerpt: The current restaurant-controlled location page identifies CIRCA at Clarendon at 3010 Clarendon Blvd, Arlington, VA 22201 and exposes the location-specific lunch, dinner, brunch, dessert, happy-hour, zero-proof, and nonalcoholic-beer menus.

The restaurant-issued Clarendon Spring 2026 lunch PDF enumerates the complete lunch food surface with item descriptions and dietary icons. It says CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment and asks guests to notify servers of food allergies or dietary restrictions.

The restaurant-issued Clarendon Spring 2026 dinner PDF enumerates the complete dinner food surface with item descriptions and dietary icons. It repeats the not-a-gluten-free-environment and server-notification statements.
The restaurant-issued Clarendon Spring 2026 brunch PDF enumerates the complete brunch food, side, salad, sandwich, and flatbread surface with literal ingredient descriptions.
The restaurant-issued Clarendon Spring 2026 beverage PDF lists the current zero-proof cocktails and nonalcoholic beers; alcoholic products were excluded from the POC product boundary.
The restaurant-controlled online-ordering hub separately links the Clarendon location to the ChowNow location 34557 storefront.

The restaurant-linked ChowNow storefront identifies Circa at Clarendon at 3010 Clarendon Blvd and exposes the current takeout catalog. Its Soup of the Day descriptions name crab, chicken, and shrimp variants; it adds Broccolini and Crispy Brussels + Blue to the current union but exposes no comprehensive allergen matrix.

Four targeted search classes surfaced the current official location page and PDFs, the restaurant-linked ChowNow storefront, an official event-catalog allergy note, and stale third-party menus, but no comprehensive restaurant-issued allergen matrix, nutrition guide, or ingredient guide.

reconciliation.notes: Every one of the 93 frozen auditItemKeys is represented exactly once. Twenty-seven compressed duplicate presentations were mapped pairwise to consolidated products; three OCR/spacing variants were normalized; the rosé is outside the POC food/nonalcoholic boundary and the concatenated Sandwiches/Margherita string is a parser artifact.

findings.summary: The official location page and exact restaurant-linked ChowNow storefront consistently identify CIRCA at Clarendon at 3010 Clarendon Boulevard; other CIRCA locations were excluded.

The complete current union contains 79 consolidated food and nonalcoholic products across lunch, dinner, brunch, dessert, happy hour, zero-proof, nonalcoholic beer, and the exact linked ChowNow surface. The frozen projection contains many duplicate PDF-text presentations and omits current products and surfaces.

Current restaurant-issued item descriptions and linked-vendor soup variants support direct positive allergen evidence for many products, but do not constitute a complete allergen matrix. Products without a direct positive remain unavailable rather than being treated as allergen-free.

The current lunch and dinner PDFs explicitly say CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment and ask guests to notify servers of allergies or restrictions. This restaurant-level evidence is preserved separately and not generalized as per-item mayContain data.
All four required search classes were completed, but no comprehensive restaurant-issued allergen matrix, nutrition guide, or full ingredient guide was found; matrix status is accurately_unavailable.

proposedChanges: Replace the frozen partial projection with the 79-product consolidated union of all current Clarendon food and nonalcoholic surfaces, including ChowNow-only Broccolini and Crispy Brussels + Blue.

Collapse 27 compressed duplicate presentations, normalize the three OCR/spacing variants, remove the alcohol-only rosé from the POC boundary, and remove the concatenated Sandwiches/Margherita parser artifact.

Retain only direct restaurant-issued or linked-vendor allergen positives, mark undisclosed products unavailable, and preserve the restaurant-level gluten cross-contact and allergy-notification statements separately from product mayContain fields.
Keep the matrix status accurately_unavailable until a comprehensive restaurant-issued allergen document is found.
